k=1.program:
import perceval as pcvl
import numpy as np

c = pcvl.Circuit(2)
for i in range(1):
    c.add(0, pcvl.BS())
    c.add((0,), pcvl.PS(np.pi/4))
c.add(0, pcvl.BS())

print(pcvl.Serializable(c).dump())
